visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a black patterned tube top and denim skirt, stands in a hallway decorated with a red Chinese New Year banner. She has her arms crossed and looks annoyed while looking into the camera. (2) She pulls out a black card and taps it against a digital keypad on a dark door. The camera follows her as she enters a bright indoor room. (3) She approaches a bed where another woman is sleeping under a grey blanket. She shakes the sleeping woman's shoulder aggressively to wake her up. (4) The sleeping woman, wearing a black camisole, sits up looking groggy. They both look at a smartphone held by the first woman. (5) Transition to the second woman sitting on the bed, now looking energetic and gesturing with her hands. On-screen graphics of iPhones and text appear around her. (6) The video cuts between her speaking and screen recordings showing a mobile game app registration page and city selection menus on a smartphone interface. (7) Final shot returns to the woman on the bed giving a thumbs up and smiling warmly toward the viewer.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: Two main female creators are featured throughout the skit and the presentation.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: One woman has long black hair, wearing a tube top with a white swirl pattern and black denim shorts. The second woman has light brown hair, wearing a black Calvin Klein camisole and matching shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A modern indoor corridor leading to a bedroom. The bedroom features a grey padded headboard, white walls, and a messy bed. Screen recordings show a mobile app UI with white forms and red buttons.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched female exclamation 'Hou!' followed by rapid, frustrated Cantonese speech. A fast-tempo, bouncy electronic synthesizer melody plays in the background. (2) A sharp 'beep' sound of an electronic lock is heard, followed by the mechanical 'click' of a door opening. (3) Rustling sounds of fabric and sheets are audible as the female voice continues to shout at her friend. A second, sleepier female voice responds with a low-pitched, confused groan. (4) A comic 'whoosh' transition leads into an enthusiastic promotional pitch. The speaker's tone becomes bright and enunciated. (5) Multiple high-pitched 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects occur every few seconds to highlight on-screen graphic reveals. (6) Short, percussive digital clicks represent smartphone screen interaction during the registration tutorial sequence. The music remains consistent and upbeat until a final enthusiastic closing phrase.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Comedic Confrontation -> Product Reveal -> Instructional Tutorial -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote the '金好運' mobile game's iPhone giveaway event. It uses a comedic 'surprise wakeup' skit to capture attention before pivoting to a direct explanation of the event rules and registration process.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal call-to-action to register for a specific app to win prizes, accompanied by a step-by-step UI tutorial.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses typical social-media influencer editing styles with rapid cuts and bright text overlays to maintain high engagement for an app promotion.
